craft_evidence.madein: 100% of men's clothing (86/86 product pages state Country of Origin: India 41, Vietnam 18, USA 10, Indonesia 7, Portugal 7, Bangladesh 2, Mexico 1)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 2008, Jedd Rose sewing packs in his Fort Collins basement; Flagship (Denver RiNo) opened Nov 2013
craft_evidence.process: partial: garment-dyed, pre-shrunk, fabric weights (gsm/oz) stated on pages; no loom/cut-and-sew process documentation; factories unnamed ("100% of factory partners Fair Wear and/or Fair Trade certified"; 80% of assortment in a Fair Trade Certified factory as of 2025)
craft_evidence.reasoning: States country of origin on every men's clothing page and has a dated, placed founding story, but owns no factory, names no maker or mill on product pages (factory partners are described only as Fair Trade/Fair Wear certified), and men's clothing is made mostly in India and Vietnam. Fits "states a country and little else", lifted by the dated heritage. Proposal only.

ownership.owner: Privately held; Gart Capital Partners made a growth investment in 2023. Founders Jedd Rose and Mark Hansen still run it.
